Element.attribute: JAN 2025 - Contributed responsibilities to main description and added key considerations.

The Solution Architect is typically responsible for:

  • Confirming that the client's operational strategy is fully supported by the target state solution design
  • Confirming that the project-specific business process design meets business needs
  • Leading or overseeing the process design workshops
  • Identifying project-specific processes and functional gaps
  • Overseeing the resolution of identified gaps and solution design issues
  • Supporting project-specific planning and delivery of change activities
On large implementations, a Solution Architect oversees the work of the Functional Architects.
